caption: The drawing depicts a single tall, rectangular wooden cabinet with long legs and a simple structure. It has two doors on the upper section, each door containing three square panels, for a total of six. Each panel is decorated with an intricate punched-tin design featuring circular and star-like patterns. Below the doors, there is a single wide drawer with two small, round knobs or handles. The cabinet’s color is a light tan or beige tone, and the punched-tin panels are depicted in a similar shade. The lines in the drawing are clear and precise, and the composition centers the cabinet, showing it from a flat, front-facing perspective. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white. The artist's signature is located in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Cabinet
